concept.title: Meaning of VPN
concept.shortdesc: This chapter talks about the meaning of VPN.

conbody.p: VPN is the creation of a private network through the use of encryption on the public network. It creates encryption between the client PC used for connecting to Internet and the remote server. Through this encryption, the data is also protected. It masks your IP address, so it ensures that no one can know where are your browsing the Internet from. It hides and changes the digit of your IP address so that the server location cant be detected by tracking authorities like the government.

It is used by organizations for their internal employees so that they can access the content from anywhere, without revealing their location to the hackers. Since the IP address gets changed under this technology, the corporate server can’t be traced by the hackers.
